title: Critique: IIT's exclusion postulate denies existence to non-maximal systems

statements.text: Under IIT's exclusion axiom, a rock is not an actual system because maxima of integrated information lie in its separate parts, and a brainstem would be cut out of the main complex. Yet rocks have emergent properties, so exclusion fits poorly with a general account of emergence and with FEP-AI.

sources.quote: according to IIT’s exclusion axiom, rocks would not represent actual systems, in that maxima of integrated information would likely be found among separate components
Brainstems would therefore be excluded from a MICS/MICE, since its inclusion would generate less Phi.
